title: Lookup came back empty? Ask whether it actually looked
head: What happened
Subagent should report
Coordinator can
rows: Failure type, query tried, partial results
rule: Never let a failed lookup look like an empty one. Report the failure, the query and any partial results.

title: A subagent hits an error: handle it, or hand it up?
head: Situation
Right handling
Why
rows: Structured error + partial results to coordinator
Hides what was tried and what remains
rule: Handle brief glitches locally. Hand up long failures with type, query, partial results and alternatives.
